4. Four has four sides when you make a square.
5. Five is halfway to ten and found on each hand.
6. Six is the smallest perfect number in mathematics.
7. Seven is considered lucky in many cultures worldwide.
8. Eight looks like a sideways infinity symbol ∞.
9. Nine is the largest single digit number.
10. Ten completes the first decade and uses two digits.
11. Eleven is a palindromic number that reads the same forwards.
12. Twelve divides the year into months and hours into cycles.
13. Thirteen is traditionally considered an unlucky number superstition.
14. Fourteen is two weeks and half a month.
15. Fifteen is a quarter of an hour in minutes.
16. Sixteen is two to the fourth power.
17. Seventeen is a prime number with no factors.
18. Eighteen is the legal age of adulthood in many places.
19. Nineteen is the largest prime number before twenty.
20. Twenty is a score and twice ten.
21. Twenty-one is the drinking age in the United States.
22. Twenty-two is a palindromic number itself.
23. Twenty-three is prime and appears in many mathematical sequences.
24. Twenty-four hours make up a full day.
25. Twenty-five is five squared in simple multiplication.
26. Twenty-six letters exist in the English alphabet.
27. Twenty-seven is three cubed or three to the third power.
28. Twenty-eight days approximate a lunar month cycle.
29. Twenty-nine is a prime number rarely
